item.description: The Chief of the Air Staff (CAS), Air Marshal Sunday Aneke, has stressed that effective public communication has become an operational necessity in the fight against terrorism, warning that misinformation, disinformation and hostile narratives can undermine military operations and public confidence.

item.title: Togo’s Faure Gnassingbé emerges as key mediator in Mali crisis
item.dc:creator: The Africa Report
item.description: A week after the release of 82 Malian soldiers held by the FLA and JNIM, the separatists released two Wagner mercenaries on 20 August. Treading a thin line between the Malian junta and the separatists, Togo’s Faure Gnassingbé has become the regional mediator no one expected.
